explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 83 configurations over 8 sweeps (topology-ep, batch-caps, prefill-chunking, moe-collective, drafting, routing-prefix-cache, kv-headroom, cudagraph), each at 3 load levels, every run on exactly 32 GPUs.

4x TP8 + EP (5 draft tokens), from the drafting sweep, reached 102.65 tok/s/accelerator (3284.8 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 96 while holding the scenario's SLOs. Ranking: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs.
4x TP8 + EP (5 draft tokens) at concurrency 96. 45 of 249 runs held the SLOs.

meta: deterministic sweep — no LLM in the measurement path
scope: cluster; worst instance for TTFT and end-to-end gates
recommendation_prose: The table below lists the measured operating points. Headline ranking: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs. The Pareto front of every sweep is in pareto.json.

prose: Wide tp8 instances should win at the SLO, and EP should pay more as dp spreads 128 experts over more ranks.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 at 38.12 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: topology-ep

prose: max_num_seqs 16 should bind on 4 instances but not 8, while a larger token budget lifts both until ITL breaks.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP (batch tokens 32,768) at 38.21 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: batch-caps

prose: Capping long prefills should cut ITL p99 enough to push the SLO knee past 96 lanes, at a small cost in raw throughput.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP (prefill chunk 4,096) at 38.01 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: prefill-chunking

prose: DeepEP low-latency should win at EP width 4-8 and lose to high-throughput at width 32, where dispatch volume dominates.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP at 38.09 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: moe-collective

prose: dspark should raise tok/s/GPU at K 3-5 but lift ITL p99 toward the 20ms SLO, so the best K may differ between shapes.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP (5 draft tokens) at 102.65 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 96).
sections.title: Sweep: drafting

prose: prefix-affinity with caching on should win, and the routing spread should widen from 4 to 8 instances.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP (prefix-affinity routing) at 38.02 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: routing-prefix-cache

prose: gmu 0.95 should lift the KV-starved tp4 shapes noticeably and leave tp8 flat.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP at 38.09 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: kv-headroom

prose: FULL and FULL_AND_PIECEWISE should edge out the PIECEWISE default by a few percent, and NONE should collapse.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP (graph capture full) at 38.17 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: cudagraph

standfirst: A deterministic sweep over custom (not in the catalog) (AgentX run recipe: 300 s idle-gap cap, 10 warm-up requests per lane, trajectory start 0.25 to 0.75, 3600 s window, 30 s grace, corpus semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126) traffic, comparing 8 designs on one GPU budget.
